name: kintone
description: - 画像一括ダウンロード: `image_bulk_download.js`   - 登録情報: `snippets_registry.json`

scripts.build:excel-pivot-ng: npm --prefix plugins/KintoneExcelPivotViewer-ng run build && npm --prefix plugins/KintoneExcelPivotViewer-ng run build:config

scripts.check:all: npm run check:attachment-name-guard && npm run check:comment-reply-label && npm run check:manual-plugin && npm run check:kintone-data-flow && npm run check:kintone-calendar
scripts.check:manual-plugin: node --check plugins/ManualPlugin/js/utils.js && node --check plugins/ManualPlugin/js/desktop.js && node --check plugins/ManualPlugin/js/viewer.js && node --check plugins/ManualPlugin/js/editor.js && node --check plugins/ManualPlugin/js/manager.js && node --check plugins/ManualPlugin/js/template.js && node --check plugins/ManualPlugin/js/config.js
scripts.package:attachment-name-guard: npm run check:attachment-name-guard && kintone-plugin-packer --ppk plugins/AttachmentNameGuard.ppk plugins/AttachmentNameGuard --out plugins/AttachmentNameGuard.zip
scripts.package:comment-reply-label: npm run check:comment-reply-label && kintone-plugin-packer --ppk plugins/CommentReplyLabel.ppk plugins/CommentReplyLabel --out plugins/CommentReplyLabel.zip
scripts.package:field-focus-input: npm run build:field-focus-input && kintone-plugin-packer --ppk plugins/FieldFocusInput.ppk plugins/FieldFocusInput --out plugins/FieldFocusInput.zip
scripts.package:field-transfer: npm run build:field-transfer && kintone-plugin-packer --ppk plugins/FieldTransfer.ppk plugins/FieldTransfer --out plugins/FieldTransfer.zip
scripts.package:kintone-data-flow: npm run check:kintone-data-flow && kintone-plugin-packer --ppk plugins/KintoneDataFlow.ppk plugins/KintoneDataFlow --out plugins/KintoneDataFlow.zip
scripts.package:kintone-lookup-filter: npm run build:kintone-lookup-filter && kintone-plugin-packer --ppk plugins/KintoneLookupFilter.ppk plugins/KintoneLookupFilter --out plugins/KintoneLookupFilter.zip
scripts.package:manual-plugin: npm run check:manual-plugin && kintone-plugin-packer --ppk plugins/ManualPlugin.ppk plugins/ManualPlugin --out plugins/ManualPlugin.zip
scripts.package:simple-task-board: npm run build:simple-task-board && kintone-plugin-packer --ppk plugins/SimpleTaskBoard.ppk plugins/SimpleTaskBoard --out plugins/SimpleTaskBoard.zip
